violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Written Procedures
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not prepared and stored according to written procedures: Observed raw shell eggs being cooked using a sous vide method in a water bath.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be prepared and stored according to written procedures that have obtained approval from the regulatory authority, are maintained in the food establishment and are available to the regulatory authority upon request, describe hot the requirements are to be monitored and documented and corrective actions taken, describe how the foods are to be marked as foods that must be further cooked, describe how the foods are to be separated from ready-to-eat foods. EHS discussed with PIC and instructed that raw shell eggs must be cooked to order until the corporation makes a decision on cooking process and provides logs for the non-continuous cooking process.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Almond milk at 50F and Half&Half at 55F in carafes at service line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS discussed with PIC that all TCS foods shell be held at a temperature of 41 or below unless the permit holder is using TPHC. PIC discarded almond milk and half&half. PIC agreed to use TPHC for almond milk and half&half in carafe. EHS provided a written agreement to PIC.
